g.text: Budget build: TM1637 4-digit 7-segment module, panel button, optional footswitch jack
Raspberry Pi 5 / Pi 4. Physical header pin numbers, BCM GPIO names. Power off before wiring. Source: hardware/SPEC.md §1, §3.1, §3.4, §3.5
Wire colours: orange 3.3 V · black GND · violet (purple) TM1637 CLK · grey TM1637 DIO · green panel button (GPIO17) · white footswitch (GPIO27)
Shaded parts (W3, SPLICE, R1, C1, JACK) are the OPTIONAL footswitch, wired exactly as in the Stage build. Dashed line = component lead soldered directly, no wire.
TM1637 VCC goes to 3.3 V (pin 17), never 5 V: the module pulls CLK and DIO up to its VCC.

g.title: PI
g.text: Only the pins used by this build are shown.

g.title: W2
g.text: Dupont jumper F-F, far housing cut off
Female housing on the Pi. Button end: strip 5 mm,
solder to the lug under 4.8 mm heat-shrink, or clamp in the screw terminal.

g.title: W3
g.text: Dupont jumper F-F, far housing cut off
OPTIONAL footswitch leads. Female housing on the Pi. Trim to about 15 cm.
White: ends in the splice with R1 and C1 (3.2 mm heat-shrink).
Black: SLEEVE lug, shared with C1 (4.8 mm heat-shrink).

g.title: TM1637
g.text: VCC = 3.3 V only (10 kΩ pull-ups to VCC).
Header order varies by vendor: wire by the printed labels.

g.title: BUTTON
g.text: Panel button, 16 mm momentary, normally open
2-lug switch - either way round. 3-lug switch - use C and NO, leave NC free.

g.title: SPLICE
g.text: OPTIONAL: solder splice at the jack

g.title: R1
g.text: other lead into the TIP lug

g.title: C1
g.text: other lead into the SLEEVE lug

g.title: JACK
g.text: OPTIONAL: 1/4-inch (6.35 mm) mono TS jack, open frame
Extra switch lug, if present: leave free.
